obligations.target: Verifies that the PDF generator renders the complete, untruncated human-readable authorization URL alongside the QR code in the document output.
obligations.reason: Unit testing the PDF generation logic directly asserts text layout and string presence without browser overhead.

obligations.target: Verifies that the human-readable authorization URL string is identical to the URL encoded in the generated QR code.
obligations.reason: Pure logic verification comparing the text URL output against the QR code payload generated by the authorization PDF builder.

obligations.target: Verifies that navigating directly to the authorization URL authorizes the device and produces setup confirmation.
obligations.reason: Tests the route handler logic for processing authorization tokens and setting device state; would gain e2e-playwright coverage at thorough, but at standard effort unit coverage on the handler is sufficient.

obligations.target: Verifies that navigating to an expired or revoked authorization URL denies authorization and displays an expired link error.
obligations.reason: Tests the route handler validation logic for expired or invalid authorization sessions; would gain e2e-playwright coverage at thorough, but at standard effort unit coverage on the handler is sufficient.

obligations.target: Verifies that PDF generation requests with missing or unknown event parameters fail validation, display an error, and produce no authorization PDF.
obligations.reason: Unit testing input validation and error responses directly covers parameter validation logic efficiently.
